grammar.summary: 本课围绕「病态幽默」展开，重点运用了 Whether...or not 让步结构、No matter where 让步状语从句以及 which/who 引导的定语从句。体会作者如何用 Whether...or not 表达「无论是否觉得好笑」、用 No matter where 强调喜剧效果的普遍性、用定语从句补充幽默的来源与人物。

points.title: Whether...or not 让步结构 (Concessive Whether)
points.explanation: Whether A or not 表示「无论是否 A」，引导让步状语从句，强调两种情况都成立。本课开篇用 Whether we find a joke funny or not 总括「笑不笑取决于成长环境」，统领全篇论点。

examples.en: Whether we find a joke funny or not largely depends on were we have been brought up.
examples.cn: 我们觉得一则笑话是否好笑，很大程度取决于我们是在哪儿长大的。

points.title: No matter where 让步状语从句 (Concessive No matter)
points.explanation: No matter + 疑问词（where/what/who/how）表示「无论……」，引导让步状语从句，强调在任何条件下都成立。本课用 No matter where you live 强调卓别林早期电影的喜剧效果具有普遍性。

examples.en: No matter where you live, you would find it difficult not to laugh at, say, Charlie Chaplin's early films.
examples.cn: 比如说，不管你生活在哪里，你看查理·卓别林的早期电影很难不发笑。

points.title: which/who 引导的定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: which/that 指物、who 指人引导定语从句。本课用 which 修饰 joke（令英国人笑出泪来的笑话）、who 修饰 a man（摔断右腿被送医院的人），使说明与叙事具体化。

examples.en: a Russian might fail to see anything amusing in a joke witch would make an Englishman laugh to tears.
examples.cn: 一则可以令英国人笑出泪来的笑话，俄国人听了可能觉得没有什么可笑之处。

examples.en: A man who had broken his right leg was taken to hospital a few weeks before Christmas.
examples.cn: 圣诞节前几周，某人摔断了右腿被送进医院。

exercises.q: ______ we find a joke funny or not largely depends on where we have been brought up.
______ where you live, you would find it difficult not to laugh at Charlie Chaplin's early films.
A man ______ had broken his right leg was taken to hospital a few weeks before Christmas.
用动词的适当形式填空：The sense of humour is mysteriously ______ (bind) up with national characteristics.
课文中 he kept on pestering his doctor to tell him when he would be able to go home 的 pestering 意思是？
